avis.titre: Very strong, and gave me consistent results!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is an intense peel, way more than I even expected. It was so strong that I was super sensitive to even the light coming through my windows for two days, so this is definitely something to consider if you want a powerful but non-harsh peel! The product itself is pretty easy to use and straightforward, and is very mess-free. It caused a little irritation (as in tingling, slight eye irritation, and heat), yet it died down after an hour or so. This did okay in melting through my old acne scars, and found that two peels were needed to lighten them up to 2 levels. Definitely needed some time to "recover" between uses (as in 4-5 days), but it's never caused a burn or too much excessive flaking or peeling the more I use. This does require a strong moisturizer since it dried out my skin pretty noticeably. Would still recommend since it's still effective, though experimenting is needed to see how many peels can work out for you.

Upon first swipe with Pad 1 I did feel some tingling on my skin, but I didn't have any negative reaction like instant redness or any irritation. After step 2, it seemed to have calmed down that feeling, which again is completely normal with this kind of peel, and I let it sit on my skin for the 10 minutes before rinsing it off. My pores had already appeared smaller, and my there was a nice evenness to my skin, while also calming down some of my redness. As you can see in my before and after photo, the results are subtle but there is a visible glow to my skin, along with smoothing and reducing my previous dullness. I applied face lotion after and I'm really happy with the results. I love how gentle yet effective these pads work, and there is a 6 week supply which is a great value. This was my first time trying a chemical peel, and I'll admit I was a little apprehensive at first. However, my esthetician actually recommended a chemical peel to lighten some dark spots on my face, so I jumped at the opportunity to try the Exuviance Advanced Series Performance Peel AP and I'm so glad I did! The process was surprisingly simple, and the instructions were very clear and easy to follow. The kit includes a 2-step system with 13 activator pads and 13 neutralizer pads, which equals about a 6-week supply. I also appreciated that they included an extra set for patch testing on an inconspicuous area of the face. The instructions specifically recommend doing this, which is especially helpful for beginners like me who may not think about patch testing beforehand. After trying the Exuviance Advanced Series Performance Peel AP, I was honestly amazed by the results!! Since it's an at-home system, I wasn't sure what to expect, but the box does state "professional level peel" and it truly felt that way — without any mixing of chemicals, special applicators, or mess! I used the activator pad, left it on for 10 minutes, used the neutralizer pad and then rinsed everything off. Immediately afterwards, my skin was incredibly soft. The new texture of my face reminded me of results you'd get from a really good exfoliating scrub but even better. I even noticed some spots in my face start to fade and my face had a beautiful glow (that even my husband noticed several days later). For

avis.titre: The Exuviance Performance Peel AP25 is a high-performance...

With a potent 25% blend of Alpha Hydroxy Acids (AHAs) and Polyhydroxy Acid (PHA), including Glycolic Acid, Mandelic Acid, and Gluconolactone, this peel effectively exfoliates the skin's surface. This product stands out for its ability to deliver professional-grade results, offering a noticeable improvement in skin texture and radiance after just a few uses.
